bank_name: National Credit and Commerce Bank PLC
period_note: Half-Yearly unaudited report used as the project's Q2 data point. Cumulative-from-Jan-1 convention established from the filing's own column header '01 January 2015 to 30 June 2015'. Standalone/Solo basis. Source PDF (half_yearly_report_2015.pdf) is a native digital PDF with a clean pdftotext -layout extraction; figures cross-verified: balance sheet ties to the taka (Total liabilities 126,034,185,157 + Total shareholders' equity 14,843,768,932 = Total assets 140,877,954,089); Profit before tax 1,102,045,514 - Provision for tax 619,993,019 = Profit after tax 482,052,495, matching the filing's own EPS of 0.55. Cross-check: comparative '31 December 2014' Total assets (BDT 135,159.52mn) matches the existing bank_financials/NCCBANK/quarterly/2014_Q4.json almost exactly; Total shareholders' equity (BDT 14,349.69mn) is about 0.7% above that file's BDT 14,249.14mn, the same small gap noted in the 2015_Q1 file. Note: the comparative 'H1 2014' EPS shown here (0.38) differs from the 0.42 reported contemporaneously in the 2014_Q2.json record even though Profit after tax for that period is identical (BDT 333.46mn in both) -- paid-up capital rose from BDT 8,029.25mn (Dec 2014) to BDT 8,832.18mn (June 2015) in the interim, consistent with a bonus share issue that would trigger a routine retrospective EPS restatement under BAS 33; this is a normal share-count effect, not a profit restatement, so the 2014_Q2.json PAT figure was not altered.

source.source_page_lines: Source PDF: standalone Balance Sheet 'As at 30 June 2015' and standalone Profit and Loss Account 'For the half-year/quarter ended 30 June 2015' (pdftotext -layout lines 245-305 and 306-365 of the extracted text).
